# Upjet facts: what they turned into

[`hack/upjet/provider-upjet-aws.json`](../../hack/upjet/provider-upjet-aws.json) is factory's fold of crossplane-contrib/provider-upjet-aws v2.10.0 onto our API resources (HFL-697): references, ID formats, late-init ignores, secrets, the maintainers' tested flag and examples, as data.
